style_rules.useStlAlgorithm: Explicit loops are accepted project style; replacing them is not a quality defect.
style_rules.shadowFunction: Callback parameter names may match snapshot/status accessor names without changing lookup at their call sites.
style_rules.useInitializationList: Assignment of SDK handles during construction is accepted project style.
style_rules.returnByReference: Snapshot APIs intentionally return independent values; do not change ownership semantics for this suggestion.
style_rules.constVariableReference: Local const qualification is a discretionary style choice.
style_rules.constVariablePointer: Local const qualification is a discretionary style choice.
style_rules.constParameterCallback: SDK callback signatures must retain their declared parameter types.
style_rules.cstyleCast: C-compatible SDK mocks may use C-style casts.
style_rules.constParameterPointer: SDK-compatible mock signatures and local const qualification are not report gates.
style_rules.noExplicitConstructor: Adding explicit changes existing public construction semantics and requires an API decision.
style_rules.missingOverride: Explicit destructor override spelling is optional; base destructors are already virtual.

messages: Virtual function 'shutdown' is called from destructor '~HttpsOtaService()' at line 91. Dynamic binding is not used.
reviewed_findings.reason: The destructor intentionally invokes its own shutdown implementation; derived dispatch is not needed.

messages: Variable 'context' is assigned a value that is never used.
reviewed_findings.reason: The worker context is passed to xTaskCreate and consumed by worker_entry_; the SDK is not present in this scan.

messages: Variable 'csi_buf[16]' is assigned a value that is never used.
reviewed_findings.reason: The buffer aliases csi_info.buf and is consumed through process_packet and the interceptor callback.

messages: Variable 'payload[bin*2+1]' is assigned a value that is never used.
Variable 'payload[bin*2]' is assigned a value that is never used.
reviewed_findings.reason: The payload aliases info.buf and is consumed by the capture service; callback counts verify the resulting rejection.
VHT support intentionally becomes false on targets without CONFIG_SOC_WIFI_HE_SUPPORT.
A repeated lock attempt can time out independently after unlock; the FreeRTOS synchronization model is external.

messages: Return value 'fail_("unexpected data after JSON array")' is always false
reviewed_findings.reason: fail_ returns false while recording the parse error; its side effect is required.

messages: Operator '|' with one operand equal to zero is redundant.
reviewed_findings.reason: ArduinoJson overloads operator | to provide a default value; this is not a bitmask.

Same expression used in consecutive assignments of 'min_motion_eval' and 'max_motion_eval'.
